about_the_game:
"

Running in the Shadows


Art by:  Allen Michael N. Geneta  




Layout by: Anna Michelle  Meservier  


Enter the Portal into a world of intrigue, technology, and magic!
Running in the Shadows is another entry in our ongoing & popular series of PC, NPC and Monster tokens.
Expand your cast of Fixers, Skilled Professionals, Contacts, and Corporate Executives with 24 beautifully drawn tokens perfect for your cyberpunk campaign. Additionally, each token has eleven thematically appropriate variants so you can find just the right style for your campaign.
As always our tokens are fully compatible with any of our One Minute Maps series!
Enjoy! "
